Implemented [ContactForm.tsx](/workspace/app/ContactForm.tsx) with name, email, and message fields and an inline server action. The action checks that all three values are present and contain more than whitespace, then logs the submitted message on the server. The project has no contact delivery or storage service, so submissions are not persisted.

Verification passed: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, and `git diff --check`.
